name: Patterson Elite
old_description: In 1993, the sweet taste of US Nationals victory was finally theirs. “That was the biggest win I’ve ever had. There are so many guys that are great racers that through their whole career haven’t had the opportunity to win at Indy. We had been going to that race since 1976 religiously. To finally get over that hump and win it, that’s the big one.”
about:
Patterson Elite operates from Augusta, Kansas, tracing its roots to 1976 when Allan Patterson turned his garage-based engine-building hobby into a full-time business by 1979. The company remains family-run, with Allan’s son Todd Patterson now leading operations alongside him.

The shop builds custom race engines and provides a full suite of in-house machining services, including block machining, piston machining, crankshaft balancing, cylinder and line honing, and Superflow engine dyno testing. It also upgrades and customizes COPO Camaros for Sportsman and Factory Stock competition, and acts as a dealer for over 100 high-performance product lines. The staff collectively holds over 100 years of expertise, and every engine is custom engineered, dyno tested, and tuned before it leaves the facility.

Patterson Elite serves drag racers across categories from Sportsman and Competition Eliminator to Factory Stock, Pro Stock, and Pro Stock Truck. Its customers include individual racers and teams looking for turnkey engines, precision machining, or race-ready COPO Camaros, as well as buyers of performance parts from the company’s warehouse outlet.

The company says its differentiation comes from its lightweight piston heritage, in-house coating capabilities for piston skirts and domes, and the 2016 merger with Elite Motorsports that brought world-champion Pro Stock technology into its engine programs. Patterson Elite emphasizes that racers want to buy from someone they trust, and it aims to deliver that trust through custom engineering and race-proven services.
